tooltips.service: The service that added this work to the order.
tooltips.role: Filled from the work's default role; change it freely.
tooltips.rate: Prefilled from the rate matrix and editable. Clear the field to re-resolve it.
tooltips.share: Percent of the rate for this line. To split a work between two employees, add the same work twice — e.g. 50 % + 50 %.
tooltips.amountManual: Set automatically when you type an amount. While on, the rate x share is not recomputed — edit the rate or the share to hand control back.
tooltips.doneAt: When the work was marked done (tablet or CRM). Written once; clear it to re-stamp.
tooltips.startedAt: When the employee pressed "Start" on the tablet.
tooltips.doneBy: Who marked the work done. On the tablet it is always the work's performer.
